messages: It seems #p425# of #m10003007# has an exciting offer for me.
#p425# of #m10003007# said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find #b#p426##k.
#p426# of #m10003007# gruffly told me all about houses.
name: The Right to Own a Home
